name: page-layout
title: Page Layout
description: The page-width contract — the prose/default/full vocabulary AppShellPage takes, and definePageWidths, one route → width map that a page, its loading skeleton and a test all read.

meta.whenToUse: Choosing how wide a page is — declare every route's width once with definePageWidths and read it from the page's AppShellPage, its loading skeleton and a route test.
meta.whenNotToUse: A page outside AppShell (sign-in, a marketing page) — it owns its own layout.
